root_cause.text: The claim reference was released via batadv_claim_put() before removing the claim from the hash list, allowing the claim to be freed while its hash_entry was still linked, leading to a use-after-free when hlist_del_rcu() accesses the freed memory.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves batadv_claim_put() after hlist_del_rcu() to ensure the claim's hash entry is removed before the reference that the list entry represents is released. The commit message explains that "the batadv_claim_put() must not be done before the last access to the claim object in this function" because it could trigger freeing via batadv_claim_release() while the list entry is still needed.
